name: DDC handleDeductFee missing access control
summary: DDC (a BananaSwap token) exposed handleDeductFee without access control; it debits _balances[from] for any address. The attacker called it with the DDC/USDT pair as from, moving the pair's DDC to the fee handlers, synced the pair and swapped a little DDC for nearly all of its USDT.
notes: The fee configuration set after deployment only routes the debited DDC to fee handlers; the unguarded debit works without it, so deployment is the reset.
Campaign: five follow-up handleDeductFee calls by the same attacker contract on the already-drained pair (dust USDT). Only USDT is counted; the pair's DDC was the lever, not separate value.
